reviews.text: "Absolutely wonderful experience at Medivet Stroud Green! Aurora, the vet who looked after my cat Oreo, was incredible so kind, gentle, understanding, and truly caring. She made me feel completely at ease. The clinic is spotlessly clean and welcoming, and the whole team is professional. I also want to thank the reception staff for being so friendly and helpful. Thank you all so much  you're truly amazing! 🐾✨

Receptionist was friendly and polite and the clinic was clean and quiet. Vet Aurora was brilliant - she treated the acute medical issues my cat was having, looked into any potential pathologies that could have been causing the symptoms and gave me great advice for improving my cat's long-term health. All in the space of about 5 minutes so I could get my nervous cat home quickly. Excellent all round 🙏

Extremely disappointing experience. Medivet seems far more interested in extracting as much money as possible from customers than genuinely caring for animals. Despite a fully paid 12-month membership, I was charged an outrageous price for my cat’s neutering. According to their own policy, I should have received a 15% discount. However, after extensive arguing, the receptionist used a series of absurd and unreasonable excuses to deny me the discount entirely.

They also repeatedly tried to persuade me to pay for additional tests that I did not consider necessary.

I had planned to renew my membership for another year, but this experience has completely destroyed my trust in Medivet. Refusing a customer a £15 discount while pushing unnecessary expenses is disgraceful. In my experience, profit comes first at Medivet, not animal welfare or customer care.
The vet and the receptionist at the Tollington Park branch were both lovely, having fitted me in when I couldn't get an appointment at my usual Medivet branch (Hornsey Road)
Both the vet and the veterinary nurse were very friendly and professional.  10 out of 10 for service, thank you very much.

I'm not entirely sure if this vet is good or not. For something is excellent, but for other things, it's very poor.
I got a cat and at least 2 a year is been checked by different vets. On my last visit, the vet told me that they have to remove 4 teeth! I mean, in all the other occasions were the teeth good!? If you bring your pet twice a year for a check-up, they aren't able to find the issue before getting that bad?
Very kind service with an amazing portuguese vet. I totally recommend

Dr Aurora was amazing with my difficult dog and has been very helpful in explaining her diagnosis and treatment. Even though she seen us as an emergency she took her time to go through everything carefully. Thank you Aurora 🙏🏻

The vet at this Medivet practice is not good. She has, on two separate occasions, misadvised us on our cat with known kidney issues and a SUB. The first time nearly ended in our cat dying of a treatable infection over Christmas. We were advised not to investigate it by the vet at this practice. She has not done any research it seems in the intervening months. I’m not even sure if she read our cat’s charts that have been shared with Medivet. We took our cat to her again with the same symptoms for a blood test recently and she has advised her care team that her condition is not urgent, despite her creatinine levels jumping nearly 300 pts in 4 months.

She’s regularly advised us to ignore our cat’s discomfort and minimised her weight loss.

Every other medivet we’ve been to has been responsive and data driven. They’ve been serious and compassionate medical professionals. I don’t know what’s wrong with the people at this branch but they simply do not seem to be data driven or rigorous when it comes to the care they provide for people’s pets.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS. Do not take your sick animals here.

Very helpful collecting my Ziva (cat)  because a male neighbour took it on them self's to bring her here! These guys called so least I knew she was safe! Thx you guys. Ziva had a cold/virus shes all better now!
Annoying that there's regularly noone at reception and noone answers when the bell is rung. Third time I've had to give up and look somewhere else for what I need.
Friendly and knowledgeable staff and vet.

I took my cat Minnie to this practice as an emergency because he had a urinary blockage. They attempted to catheterise him but were unable to complete the procedure. Instead, they removed some urine directly from his bladder to keep him stable long enough for me to transfer him to an emergency hospital, where further treatment was still required.

Despite the catheterisation being unsuccessful, I was charged nearly £1,100. When I arrived at the hospital and explained what had happened, the receptionist immediately questioned why I had been charged the full amount when the main procedure had not been completed successfully.

I understand that the practice is entitled to charge for the emergency examination, medication, sedation, equipment used, the attempted catheterisation and the temporary removal of urine. However, I do not believe it was reasonable to charge the full price as though Minnie had been successfully catheterised and unblocked when he had not.

This was already an extremely distressing emergency, and the lack of clarity surrounding the charges made the experience worse. I would strongly advise anyone using this practice to ask for a fully itemised estimate beforehand and to check carefully whether they are being charged for procedures that were attempted or procedures that were actually completed.

I am deeply disappointed with how this was handled and believe the bill should have reflected the treatment Minnie genuinely received rather than a successful procedure that did not take place.
Lots of good advice given by my vet with a clear explanation of the process for monitoring my pet.

I love all the team at medivet stroud green, they go above and beyond to look after my pets when I needed, and when I need. everyone is so kind and caring and I cant fault them, they are always there when ever ive needed. Such kind compassionate individuals who have nothing but love and care. Amazing people!!
Knowledgeable, friendly and efficient.
Their vet, Aurora, is the best that I've ever come across - so professional, thorough, generous, and totally wonderful with my cat. Always excellent reception staff, too. Highly recommend.
Friendly and knowledgable staff, good location and facilities.

I have been using Medivet Stroud Green for my dog for the last few years. Particularly in the last year we have seen the same vet Aurora for treatment and she is wonderful, friendly, professional and my dog is very comfortable around her. I'm always able to get an appointment in good time and was able to get one especially quickly when my dog required urgent attention. His care was excellent and explanations and advice around treatment options were clear and reassuring. Thank you all very much.
I highly recommend Stroud Green Medivet.all staffs very kindly and friendly.insides are very clean hygienic.they listen helped to best for my poddle dog.thank you Stroud Green Medivet.❤️
Very happy with staff at medivet in stroud green - always professional, friendly and helpful
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

Awful standards.

The manager excused a vet’s rude behaviour by saying it was “her culture to shout and be loud.” That is not an acceptable justification. It reflects both poor customer service and a troubling attitude to professional conduct. It also unfairly stereotypes people from the Iberian Peninsula.

I left seriously concerned about the standard of care and how animals might be treated when owners are not present.

If your thinking of registering here, think agian! Plenty of much better practices in a reasonable proximity.

These people do not take their jobs seriously. My cat was booked in for a serious operation which meant she could not eat for 24 hour beforehand. I scheduled the operation a month before and booked time off from work to attend as they are not open weekend, I turned up and sat down for them to realise the person was not actually attending work that day.

When I was upset that my cat had been fasting and been through the stress of a car journey, they told me that I could find a better practice if I wanted too and didn’t need to go to them!!!

Honestly, the strangest experience no apology, no empathy, just rude dismissive hostile lead vet defending the cancellation of appointment.

They have no people OR animal skills, wouldn’t let them near a worm let alone a cat!

It took 3 medivets calls before I could make an appointment,  despite my disappointment in this. Stroud Green practice gave me a next day appointment. The vet that saw to my cat, put my mind and ease and was very kind to my cat. Even though it's a small practice,  I felt very confident in the vet and the treatment of my pet.
Very caring and friendly staff who took great care and were delighted to meet our rabbits.
Very kind, caring, and professional clinic. Highly recommend!

Disgusting vet service.
My poorly puppy was even more anxious and terrified during the checkup
They charged us a ridiculous amount for a 5/10 minutes quick check up with was just to feel his tummy and patties
The vet was not friendly,
The fees was not explained to us in the initial booking or arrival however it was billed and demanded to us before we had left.
I have canceled our membership with them after this experience and will never go back
I definitely will
Not recommend

I discussed this with Ghengis my cat and he said he always enjoys his annual trip to Zasman. Save for the little issue of his needle phobia, he is always treated kindly and professionally. They clearly like animals.

My poor cat had an eye blow out...hemorrhage blood filled eye. I was stressed full of anxiety.  I called my regular Medivets who gave me allocation times and numbers to contact other vets in my area. Given the emergency of the situation.  Medivets on Tollington where brilliant, empathetic and calm.  Being anxious about my old girl kitty the vet and receptionist delt the situation incredibly well.  So thankful for their professionalism and care
The staff are always very friendly and took great care of my dog when he was being neutered. He even had a free nail trim while he was there.
The vet was diligent,full of helpful advice & very kind to my dog. What more could you want?
Performed a detailed health check of our two dogs before providing the annual vaccination booster. Provided some good advice, and was very helpful. Highly recommended.

Dra. Aurora thank you for everything, always so kind and professional. My cat Joey it's doing great. Really good job. Thank you for everything Rita, really kind and nice person. I'm really happy with both of you.
I wanted to say thank you to Dr.Aurora and Rita for everything they made for my cat Joey. Lovely and professional persons!
Very good first visit.

My cat had a very bad itch so we went to this vet. The veterinarian made me were huge gloves to hold my cat and did not Probaly examine my cat because she was aggressive and didn’t know what the problem was  and just gave a flea treatment and I payed around 80-90 pounds. My cat is still itching. Don’t recommend this vet to anyone they don’t know how to handle a cat!? Wasted my money for wrong treatment!

If you love your pet take them to a place where the staff are there for the animals wellbeing, this MEDVET STROUD GREEN vet clinic don’t really care how your pet feels, they are only there for the money… they let us down again, first time they got wrong out time slot, so they attended out 2 cats within 15min for check up and vaccines, we didn’t mind because our cats are actually health.. we’ve been told to bring our cats back for the second jabs, because we got there less then 15 late. They refuse to see our cats which was there only for the 2n vaccine, they didn’t consider we’ve travelled 1,5h, they didn’t have clue we were there only for the 2nd jab as we where there a week before.
They barely check ur pet, they don’t consider ur pets at all. IF YOU LOVE YOUR PET DO NOT BRING THEN TO STROUD GREEN MEDVET until they change this horrendous behaviour of loveless ppl.

Very unhelpful staff, twice gone there and they first cancelled an appointment without even inform us, booked 2 slots for my 2 cats and when getting there they cancelled one of the appointments even tho we had the email confirmation! But there was no explanation why…the lady at the reception just told us that was strange to her…we had out 2 cats checked and vaccinated within 15min, which for us was ok since she told us our cats were health, for the sec vaccine we booked a week after, again we booked 2 slots; and when getting there today a a few minutes late they send us away saying that there was no time to to the job as we were late, we explained that we had transport issues and the cats had travelled 1,5hour to be there as she advised to only change our branch after the second vaccine… conclusion if u love your pet DO NOT bring then in this place, they should care about your animals wellbeing, but seems like they only care about money.
We are sadly travelling back home with our cats 🐈‍⬛ unattended.. and that wasn’t about timing was about lack of care and love.

I took my kitten to medi vet and they said that they would help her but they made her worse than what she was. They sent me and my partner all over London to all the different vets and on the way she passed away so I would never recommend taking any of my other animals there.

I had an appointment with Aurora and she was amazing, I was a bit worried for my kitten who had been feeling unwell. She took care of him and reassure me that he was perfect and that it was pretty common. Also all of the reception team is amazing. I had a post check up for one of my kitten but the other one was feeling unwell. They managed to check them on the same day.

All staff, reception and vets, are polite and friendly. The vets take time to listen and interact with you and your pet, and will take time to explain matters, without you feeling rushed. The rates are also very reasonable, especially if you're signed up to one of their regular plans. Highly recommended.
My poor little Frenchie Manuel arrived at medivet with a sore toe and left in a coffin!!! I hate medivet more that anything in the world!!

It’s such a shame that Zasman sold to Medivet, and we lost the whole group of staff, Ruth lead vet, along with nurse staff like Daisy. The positive reviews on here are mainly because of the Zasman staff.
Tired of always having to see different staff, and the costs are very high. It just seems focused on profits. My pet has gone here all their life but unfortunately I will now be going to a different vet.

I wasn’t told to bring a urine sample…and the first question from the visiting doctor: Do you have a urine sample? The Stroud Green location has too many vets; I seldom see the same one twice. He didn’t check my dog’s weight or eyes, failed to notice the hair loss on my dog’s feet, and forgot to check for lumps, so I reminded him as I was being ushered out. Corporate doctoring at its absolute worst. I even had to ask him to read my pet’s history at one point! Finding an independent vet is so hard in London that I’m stuck with this.

Medivet is a really bad chain of veterinary clinics. First of all some of the vets don’t even know how to handle a cat and they were  not able to examine my cat properly.
They also charge an insane amount of money for flee and warming treatment. Almost triple the amount of the same product found online. I won’t be using their services any more. Choose local veterinary practices instead of corporations that are only looking to make profit

I had a fantastic first visit to Medivet Stroud Green with our newly adopted stray kitten, and I couldn’t be more grateful for the care we received! From the moment we walked in, the receptionist was warm, kind, and incredibly helpful, making us feel welcome and at ease.

Aurora, our vet, was absolutely wonderful—gentle, knowledgeable, and so patient in answering all our questions. She took the time to thoroughly check our kitten, offering great advice and reassurance. It’s clear that both Aurora and the entire team truly care about the well-being of animals.

Such a positive experience—highly recommend Medivet Stroud Green to any pet owner looking for compassionate and professional care!

Update - June 2025
We have been with this vet for 6 months now and couldn't be happier with the level and care of the service. From the receptionists, to the nurses and the vets everyone is friendly, professional and extremely caring. We couldn't recommend it more!
We had a great first visit little kittens! The Portuguese veterinary was very sweet with them! Thank you so much xx🐱 …

My two elderly cats have been regular visitors here since they became part of my family and I was worried when Zasman was taken over by Medivet but I can honestly say that my cats have continued to receive lovely, kind, compassionate care from all the staff when they attend. Thank you Medivet team. Kx
Professional, friendly and remembered my pets name. They're level of expertise and experience is paralleled. Would recommend to 100% pet owners

My Chihuahua ate rat poison that was in garden shed without my knowledge. I had just moved in & was puppy’s first day too!  I called Medivet as a new customer. It was an emergency & I was  told to get puppy to the surgery. They saved his life. The lady vet showed me the huge piece of poison she extracted from the dog. He certainly would have died. They kept working on him even though it was past closing time. I am so grateful to Medivet’s wonderful team.

trust this vet so much my beautiful girl has been coming here and was microchipped, vaccinated and neutered here and shes healing very beautifully. they explain everything thoroughly, prices are reasonable for what the service is and theyre rly good with both us and our cat

It's a gamble what vet you will get at your appointment. Since Medivet took over, every time I went, there was a new person, sometimes even within a couple of weeks. Some of them nice, and the latest one, Dr Fernandes was excellent, but with some of them, I felt that they couldn't care less, as long as they fit the required number of patients into the day. I am happy with my latest appointment, but in general I preferred when it was Zasman Vet, and we had the one great vet all the time.

I have been using Zasmans since they opened the Stroud Green branch with my two cats.  The care and skill that they provide is second to none.  Both of our cats have had the occasion health problem but Zasmans have always got to the root of the problem and we have two contented and happy cats as a result.  If you have a cat take them there - you won't regret it.

UPDATE
Since I wrote this the practice been taken over by Medivet and the service is not the same - you never know who is going to treat your pet - some good practitioners some less so. I would much prefer to use an independent vet and would do so if one was easy to get to.

I had a fantastic experience with this vet clinic when I brought my female cat in for spaying. From start to finish, everything was handled with care and professionalism. I left my cat in their capable hands for the whole day and picked her up at 4 PM. They provided us with clear, detailed instructions on post-surgery care, which made the recovery process so much easier to manage.

Three days later, we had a follow-up appointment where the vet carefully checked her condition. They determined that another session wasn’t necessary, but kindly asked us to send in a photo after three more days for further evaluation via email. By day seven, my cat had fully recovered, and the procedure was a complete success!

The staff, including both the nurse and vet, were incredibly friendly and caring throughout. It’s clear that they genuinely love animals, and I felt confident that my cat was in excellent hands. We’ve also come here for vaccinations and microchipping, and I can honestly say I’m very satisfied with their service.

Highly recommend this clinic for their professionalism, attention to detail, and warm approach. I’ll definitely continue bringing my cat here for future care!

Absolutely useless. Completely misdiagnosed our cat and never bothered to follow up with the blood test results. Only after going to an emergency vet they told us the blood results came back a while back & no one bothered to let us know.
When this was Zasman it was good but since Medivet took over it’s been horrendous. Stay away if you love your pet, we learned the hard way.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

At first seemed like a great experience with my dog, then had to move city with him, and a new vet put in light, that all they did was take money from me, as my dog was suffering from bad arthritis and of old age with an infection. And that any professional vet with a heart would of given me the option immediately considering my dog was 15 years at the time.

All this happened 2 months after my last visit to this medi vet, even with care and medicine provided my dog was not getting  any better. Had to move city with him, and sign up to the vets at pet at home here for them to tell me that, my dogs suffering was just being extended for financial gain.  Had to watch my dogs back legs stop working and him barely able to move because of such actions appalling!
Cookie and figaro were looked after with care and attention . Reception were really friendly and helpful and knowledgeable of my cats needs Thank you

Professional, friendly and really care for pets and owners.
They have helped us through 2 elderly cats passing.  Showed us no end of understanding and comfort.
I would recommend medivet N4 to all.
Great range of foods, toys and all important advice for all pets.
Reception are welcoming, friendly and professional.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
They are very professional veterinarians, flexible with emergency calls and they are very friendly.

I had a scheduled appointment for my pet, and no one showed up or even called to inform me of any changes. This lack of communication and professionalism is unacceptable! I expected better service and will be looking for a more reliable vet.

They have been wonderful with my cat for an emergency appointment today after she became unwell. They fit her in straight away even while they were busy, which was greatly appreciated. We had a prompt blood screen and great advice from Sam …

I have two elderly dogs both with diabetes and Cushings disease. One is with Medivet the other with Beaumont Vet in Camden. So I can compare the level of care from each.   Medivet is so much poorer. …
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
